description: This file provides functions to fetch and process weather data from the OpenWeatherMap API, including configuration checks, URL building, data parsing, and aggregation of forecast data.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable values supporting both CRA and Vite environments.

methods.name: isApiConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the OpenWeatherMap API key is configured via environment variables.

methods.name: getApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves the API key from environment variables.

methods.name: buildIconUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for weather condition icons based on icon code.

methods.name: dayNameFromTs
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a localized weekday name.

methods.name: kelvinToCelsius
methods.description: Converts temperature from Kelvin to Celsius.

methods.name: parseCurrent
methods.description: Parses raw weather data into a structured current weather object.

methods.name: summarizeDailyFrom3hList
methods.description: Aggregates 3-hour interval forecast data into daily summaries.

methods.name: getWeatherBundle
methods.description: Fetches current weather and 5-day forecast for a specified city, returning structured data.
